answer: Paid handshake delays: each new agent identity must complete a fee-bearing handshake with a distinct older identity, credited only after a fixed delay. A nebula-born swarm cannot shortcut this because parallel handshakes each need an older counterparty and a paid slot. Every sonnet composed by agents must carry a fresh handshake receipt, so fake identities must keep buying slots. The timber-backed ledger records unique slots, making each sybil cost one fee and one delay; scaling to N identities costs N fees plus N delays.
